sections.summary: The module is a campaign-creation aid showing keyword search volume.

claims.text: The Keyword Quality module appears during Search Ads Campaign creation and displays a search volume label for the selected ad group keywords and their settings.

evidence.locator: Keyword quality module and Search volume

claims.text: Search volume is the estimated number of monthly searches the keywords get in the targeting country, shown as a High, Medium, or Low label.

evidence.locator: Keyword quality module and Search volume

claims.text: The High/Medium/Low label indicates comparable size within the account's industry vertical, not an absolute count.

evidence.locator: Keyword quality module and Search volume

sections.summary: The label is relative to industry vertical and varies with match type; the packet does not describe an underlying scoring algorithm.

claims.text: The displayed volume number may change according to the match type setting.

evidence.locator: Keyword quality module and Search volume

claims.text: The label reflects comparable size within the account's industry vertical, so it is a relative signal rather than an absolute traffic guarantee.

evidence.locator: Keyword quality module and Search volume

claims.text: How the estimate is computed internally is not documented in the packet.

evidence.locator: Keyword quality module and Search volume

sections.summary: The packet only implies a use case (choosing keywords with higher volume); TikTok recommends a High label for performance.

claims.text: Keyword selection can use the label as a signal: TikTok recommends maintaining a High label for best ad group performance.

evidence.locator: Keyword quality module and Search volume

claims.text: Per the applicable conditions, if the search volume label is unavailable (certain industries), aim for at least 1M monthly searches per ad group.

sections.summary: The packet states the module appears automatically during campaign creation; no manual setup path is documented.

claims.text: The module appears during campaign creation in Ads Manager; no separate manual enablement steps are documented.

evidence.locator: Keyword quality module and Search volume

claims.text: Availability of the search volume label is limited to certain industries; otherwise a 1M monthly searches per ad group target applies.

sections.summary: The packet links the High label to 'best ad group performance' but defines no KPIs or guarantees; treat as directional.

claims.text: TikTok recommends a High search volume label for best ad group performance, but no specific KPIs, uplift magnitude, or guarantee is documented.

evidence.locator: Keyword quality module and Search volume

claims.text: The module is a reporting/diagnostic signal, not a control; the 1M monthly searches figure is a goal to aim for, not a billing or attribution metric.

sections.summary: The packet contains no cross-platform comparisons or alternative features, so no relationship claims can be made.
